mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline over 20-day forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return during declining FEDFUNDS periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 4.5% indicate a tight labor market with strong corporate hiring and wage growth, boosting consumer spending and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad economic slowdown reducing corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both decline by more than 2% in the prior month, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%) signals potential central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1,200,000 units reflect strong consumer demand and economic confidence, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1,200,000 units, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Positive year-over-year GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 year-over-year growth is positive, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%) signals an economic environment requiring aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 200,000 jobs indicates a rapidly strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS monthly change exceeds 200,000, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of such instances.
